- ʿiwaj and ʿawaj, with a kasra or a fatḥa on the ʿayn. In this verse there is a delicate rhetorical point, which is among the subtleties of the Qur'an and its firm inimitability.
The lexicographers mentioned that ʿiwaj with a kasra on the ʿayn is for abstract matters, while ʿawaj with a fatḥa on the ʿayn is for describing material matters.
But in this verse we find Him, glory be to Him, placing what is for abstract matters in the place of material matters, namely the attributes of the flattened earth in which you see no protrusion or relief.
But we need only go deeply into grasping what this usage looks toward, from noticing the absence of any protrusion, however fine, or depression, however slight, that the seeing eye does not perceive, but that the means of modern science perceive. Therefore He, glory be to Him, the Exalted, expressed, with the word set down for meanings, matters that are among the attributes of material bodies. This is a hint that hardly anyone perceives except one given penetration of insight in addition to the power of sight. So reflect, for in that is the utmost lesson and inimitability..!
And perhaps al-Khansāʾ noticed something like this meaning when she said:
يذكرني طلوع الشمس صخرا ... وأذكره لكل غروب شمس
(The rising of the sun reminds me of Ṣakhr, and I remember him at every sunset.)
For in the rising of the sun there is the launching of raids, and in its setting is the meeting-place of the guests.

safi-cedvel:108-110.t:
* I'rab:
(يومئذ) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (102) of this sūra]; attached to (يتّبعون), and the clause for which the tanwīn is a compensation is «نسفت الجبال» ("the mountains are scattered"), (لا) the lā of generic negation, (له) attached to the khabar of lā [Note: and the pronoun in it refers either to the caller, i.e. "there is no crookedness in his call", or to the following that is understood from the context of the speech or implied.], (الواو) a conjunction, (للرحمن) attached to (خشعت), (الفاء) a conjunction, (إلّا) a particle of restriction, (همسا) a direct object, accusative, and it is originally an adjective of an omitted modified noun, i.e. "speech whispered", that is "muffled".
Clause: «يتّبعون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «لا عوج له ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the caller [Note: or it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.. and it was said to be an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "you will follow the caller with a following that has no crookedness".].
And the clause: «خشعت الأصوات ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «لا تسمع ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «خشعت».
109- (يومئذ) attached to (تنفع), (إلّا) a particle of restriction [Note: it is possible that it is for exception, and (من) is in the position of an accusative as the excepted, by an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the intercession of one whom He has permitted".. or in the position of a nominative as a badal.], (من) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative direct object whose governor is (تنفع), and it is the one interceded for, (له) the first attached to (أذن), and (له) the second attached to (رضي), and the lām is for cause, i.e. "for his sake", (قولا) a direct object, accusative.
And the clause: «لا تنفع الشفاعة ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.
And the clause: «أذن له الرحمن ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative (من).
And the clause: «رضي ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
110- (ما) a relative noun, a direct object, (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of (ما), (ما) the second is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the first, (خلفهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of the second (ما), (الواو) circumstantial, (به) attached to (يحيطون), and the pronoun in it refers back to His words: "what is before them and what is behind them", (علما) a tamyīz, accusative.
And the clause: «يعلم ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «يحيطون ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the pronoun in (أيديهم) ...

* Morphology:
(همسا): a samāʿī maṣdar of the triliteral همس, of the pattern of ضرب, and its pattern is فعل with a fatḥa and a sukūn.

safi-cedvel:111-111.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (عنت) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, implied on the alif that was omitted because of the meeting of two silent letters.. and (التاء) is the feminine marker, (للحيّ) attached to (عنت), (الواو) the circumstantial wāw, (قد) a particle of certainty, (ظلما) a direct object, accusative.
Clause: «عنت الوجوه ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «خاب من ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from (الوجوه), and the link is implied [Note: it is possible that the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
And the clause: «حمل ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(عنت): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by omission; its origin is عنات; two silent letters met, the alif and the tāʾ, so the alif was dropped; its pattern is فعت.

safi-cedvel:112-112.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (من) a conditional noun that jusses, indeclinable in the position of a nominative mubtadaʾ, (من الصالحات) the min is partitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective of an omitted modified noun, i.e.:
"something of the righteous deeds", (الواو) circumstantial, and (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis, and (لا) negative, and the agent of (يخاف) refers back to (من), (ظلما) a direct object, accusative, and the second (لا) is redundant, to confirm the negation, (هضما) conjoined to (ظلما) by the wāw.
Clause: «من يعمل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: it is possible that it is conjoined to the clause «قد خاب» if that is parsed as resumptive.].
And the clause: «يعمل ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
And the clause: «هو مؤمن ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the agent of (يعمل).
And the clause: «لا يخاف ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", and the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ [Note: if the imperfect is fit to be the apodosis, it is permissible for the fāʾ to accompany it on condition that it be affirmative or negated by (لا) or (لم); the verbal clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the apodosis of the condition (see al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 4, p. 350).].

* Morphology:
(هضما): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb هضم يهضم, of the pattern of ضرب, in the sense of "he diminished" and in the sense of "he wronged and usurped", and its pattern is فعل with a fatḥa and a sukūn.

safi-cedvel:113-114.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (كذلك) attached to an omitted absolute object, its governor being (أنزلناه) [Note: it is possible that the kāf is a noun meaning "like", in which case it is in the position of an accusative absolute object standing in for the maṣdar because it is its attribute.], (قرآنا) an accusative ḥāl [Note: it is permissible to parse it as a ḥāl, although it is rigid, because it has been described.], (فيه) attached to (صرّفنا), (من الوعيد) it is an adjective of an omitted modified noun, i.e. "a kind of threat", or "a threat from among the threats" [Note: and (من) is redundant according to al-Akhfash, so (الوعيد) is a direct object, accusative in position.], and the agent of (يحدث) is a pronoun referring back to the Qur'an, (لهم) attached to (يحدث) [Note: it may be attached to a ḥāl from (ذكرا) - an adjective that precedes what it modifies.].
Clause: «أنزلناه ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «صرّفنا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to «أنزلناه».
And the clause: «لعلّهم يتّقون ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive - or causal - and the clause: «يتّقون ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of laʿalla.
And the clause: «يحدث ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause «يتّقون».
114 (الفاء) a conjunction, (الملك) an adjective (naʿt) of the sacred name (Allah), nominative, (الحقّ) a second adjective of the sacred name, nominative, (الواو) resumptive, (لا) a prohibitive that jusses, (بالقرآن) attached to (تعجل), by an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "with its recitation" or "with its revelation".. (من قبل) attached to (تعجل), (يقضى) a passive imperfect verb, accusative, its sign of accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif, (إليك) attached to (يقضى), (وحيه) the nāʾib fāʿil, nominative.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يقضى ... ) is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
(الواو) a conjunction, (ربّ) a vocative muḍāf, accusative, its sign of accusative being the implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, omitted for lightness, and the omitted (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the (النون) in (زدني) is the protective nūn, (علما) a second direct object, accusative.
Clause: «تعالى الله ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «أنزلناه».
And the clause: «يقضى إليك وحيه ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «لا تعجل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «لا تعجل».
And the vocative clause: «ربّ ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «زدني ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.

* Morphology:
(وحيه): it may be a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb وحي يحي, of the pattern of ضرب, its pattern being فعل with a fatḥa and a sukūn, and it may be a name for the angel Gabriel.

* Benefits:
- «ولا تعجل بالقراءة قبل أن يقضي إليك وحيه». In this verse there are two noble meanings: The first: He, glory be to Him, counsels us to deliberation and composure, for man was created hasty. He wishes to calm in us the surge of haste, and to put in its place gentleness and tranquillity, for that is more conducive to the success of deeds and to reaching the places of truth.
The second: He asks His Messenger to wait, until Gabriel completes the message of revelation for which he came down, so that the Messenger delivers it complete, not diminished, not in pieces, not cut short and not confused, lest that bequeath contradiction in the delivery and opposition in the rulings.
It is noticed through this verse that the Messenger ﷺ was eager to deliver what was revealed to him with the greatest possible speed. Here the human attributes in any messenger play their part, whether negatively or positively, so Allah wished to rein in this trait and to bring the Messenger ﷺ to patience and deliberation; and would that each of us benefited from this verse in wisdom, and from this divine direction in example and lesson.

safi-cedvel:115-115.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath, (إلى آدم) attached to (عهدنا), and the sign of genitive is the fatḥa, since it is a diptote because of being a proper name and non-Arabic, (قبل) an adverbial noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of a genitive, attached to (عهدنا), (له) attached to an omitted second direct object [Note: and if the verb (نجد) is transitive to one object, then the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a ḥāl from (عزما), or attached to (نجد).].
Clause: «عهدنا ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the implied oath.. and the implied oath clause is resumptive.
And the clause: «نسي ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «عهدنا».
And the clause: «لم نجد ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «نسي».

safi-cedvel:116-116.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of an accusative direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember", (للملائكة) attached to (قلنا), (لآدم) attached to (اسجدوا), (الفاء) a conjunction linking the effect to the cause, (إلّا) a particle of exception, (إبليس) accusative as a discontinuous exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) or continuous (muttaṣil), according to the disagreement about what Iblīs was when the command to prostrate was given.
Clause: «قلنا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «اسجدوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «سجدوا ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause «قلنا».
And the clause: «أبى ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.

safi-cedvel:117-119.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive, (آدم) a vocative, a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative, (لك) attached to an adjective (naʿt) of (عدوّ), (لزوجك) like (لك), so it is conjoined to it, (الفاء) the connective of an implied conditional apodosis, (لا) a prohibitive that jusses, (يخرجنّكما) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of a jussive.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and (كما) is a pronoun, a direct object, and the agent is "huwa", (من الجنّة) attached to (يخرجنّ), (الفاء) the fāʾ of causality, (تشقى) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the fāʾ, its sign of accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif, and the agent is "you". And the interpreted maṣdar (أن تشقى..) is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding prohibition, i.e.: "let there be no expulsion of you two from it, for then wretchedness for you".
Clause: «قلنا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يا آدم ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «إنّ هذا عدوّ ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
And the clause: «لا يخرجنّكما..» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if you two know his enmity, then let him not expel you two", that is, do not give him the means of expelling you.
And the clause: «تشقى ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
118- (لك) attached to an omitted khabar of inna, (فيها) attached to (تجوع), (تعرى) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تجوع).
And the interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تجوع ... ) is in the position of an accusative, the ism of inna.
And the clause: «إنّ لك أن.. تجوع ... » has no grammatical position; a resumptive within the scope of the preceding saying.
And the clause: «تجوع ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «تعرى ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle-type relative.
119- (فيها) the second attached to (تظمأ), (تضحى) an imperfect verb, nominative, conjoined to (تظمأ), and its sign of nominative is the implied ḍamma.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّك لا تظمأ..) is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar, the ism of inna.
And the clause: «لا تظمأ ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of anna.
And the clause: «لا تضحى ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause «لا تظمأ».

* Morphology:
(تعرى): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is تعري - with a yāʾ at the end - the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif.. its past is عري - with a kasra on the rāʾ - of the pattern of فرح.
(تضحى): it has an ʿilāl by substitution; its origin is تضحي, the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif.. and the (yāʾ) is originally converted from a wāw, because the past is ضحا يضحو and the noun is ضحوة; and when the weak letter became the fourth, it was written with the undotted yāʾ..

* Rhetoric:
- Cutting a counterpart off from its counterpart (qaṭʿ al-naẓīr ʿan al-naẓīr):
In His words, the Exalted: «إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيها وَلا تَعْرى، وَأَنَّكَ لا تَظْمَؤُا فِيها وَلا تَضْحى».
In this verse there is a wonderful secret of the secrets of rhetoric, called "cutting a counterpart off from its counterpart", for He separated thirst from hunger, and exposure to the sun from clothing, despite the correspondence between them. The purpose of that is to establish the enumeration of these favours and their classification; had each been joined with its like, the things enumerated would have been imagined to be one favour.

safi-cedvel:120-120.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive, (إليه) attached to (وسوس), (هل) an interrogative particle, (على شجرة) attached to (أدلّك), (ملك) conjoined to (شجرة), genitive.
Clause: «وسوس إليه الشيطان ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.
And the clause: «يا آدم ... » has no grammatical position; parenthetical, for the sake of enticement.
And the clause: «هل أدلّك ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «لا يبلى ... » is in the position of a genitive, an adjective of (ملك).

* Morphology:
(يبلى): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is يبلي, the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif; its past is بلي, of the pattern of فرح.

safi-cedvel:21-24.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive; and (السين) a particle of futurity; (سيرتها) accusative by removal of the preposition «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī permitted it to be a badal ishtimāl (inclusive substitute) for the accusative pronoun in (سنعيدها).]», i.e. إلى سيرتها (to its former state); (الأولى) an naʿt (adjective) of سيرة, genitive, its sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «خذها ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا تخف ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause خذها.
The clause «سنعيدها.....» has no grammatical position; causal.
22- (الواو) a conjunction; (إلى جناحك) attached to (اضمم); (تخرج) an imperfect verb, jussive, the answer to a request; (بيضاء) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the fāʿil (agent) of تخرج, and tanwīn is withheld from it because it ends in the extended alif of feminine; (من غير) attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in بيضاء «[Note: it may be attached to (تخرج).]»; (آية) a second ḥāl, accusative; (أخرى) an naʿt of آية, accusative, its sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif.
The clause «اضمم ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause خذها.
The clause «تخرج ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of an implied condition, not accompanied by the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلى جَناحِكَ».
The origin of الجناح (wing) is for the bird; then it was borrowed for the side of the human being, because every side is in the place of the wing of the bird, so the two sides were called two wings, by way of metaphor.
2- Precaution (iḥtirās) and metonymy (kināya):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «تَخْرُجْ بَيْضاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ».
السوء: badness and ugliness in everything, and it is used metonymically for leprosy (baraṣ), as the private parts are metonymically called السوأة, since natures recoil from it and ears spit it out. The benefit of going out of one's way to negate that is "precaution" (iḥtirās): for had He confined Himself to His saying «تَخْرُجْ بَيْضاءَ», it would have suggested — though remotely — leprosy. It is also possible that the precaution is against suggesting the defect of departing from the original creation, the meaning being: "it comes out white, without any defect or ugliness in that coming out", or against suggesting a defect in general.
23- (اللام) for causation; (من آياتنا) attached to an omitted second direct object «[Note: or attached to a ḥāl from الكبرى, taking it as the second object, being an naʿt of an omitted described, i.e. الآية الكبرى.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نريك..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "We gave you that in order to show you ...".
The clause «نريك ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
24- (إلى فرعون) attached to (اذهب), and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa because it is a diptote..
The clause «اذهب ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «إنّه طغى ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «طغى ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(سيرة): the noun from سار يسير, or with the meaning of "condition" and "way", on the pattern فعلة with kasra then sukūn.
(الكبرى): a noun of preference (ism tafḍīl), on the pattern فعلى with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn, and it is the feminine of أكبر.. a singular used to describe a plural, which is permissible; and had it been, outside the Revelation, a plural, it would have been permissible — i.e. كبر with ḍamma then fatḥa, or كبريات.
(طغى): it has a weak-letter change by conversion; its origin is طغي; the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to alif, and the alif is written in the form of the undotted yāʾ because it is triliteral and the origin of the alif in it is yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:25-35.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّ) a vocative muḍāf (annexed), accusative, its sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on what precedes the yāʾ that was dropped for lightening, and (الياء) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لي) attached to (اشرح), a supplicatory imperative verb..
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «النداء وجوابها ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) «[Note: the clause of the vocative may be parenthetical, for seeking mercy and supplication, and the clause اشرح the content of the saying.]».
The clause «اشرح ...» has no grammatical position; the answer to the vocative.
26- (الواو) a conjunction; the second (لي) attached to (يسّر).
The clause «يسّر ...» is conjoined to the clause اشرح and takes its parsing.
27- (الواو) a conjunction; (من لساني) attached to an naʿt (adjective) of عقدة.
The clause «احلل ...» is conjoined to the clause اشرح.
28- (يفقهوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the answer to a request, its sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «يفقهوا ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of an implied condition, not accompanied by the fāʾ, i.e. "if you untie the knot of my tongue, they will understand my speech..".
29- (الواو) a conjunction; (لي) attached to an omitted second direct object; (من أهلي) attached to an naʿt of (وزيرا).
The clause «اجعل ...» is conjoined to the clause اشرح.
30- (هارون) a badal (substitute) for (وزيرا), accusative «[Note: (هارون) may be a first direct object of the verb اجعل, and (وزيرا) a second object, and (لي) attached to (اجعل).]»; (أخي) an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) for هارون, accusative, its sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on what precedes the yāʾ ... and (الياء) is a muḍāf ilayhi.
31- (اشدد) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is أنت; (به) attached to (اشدد).
The clause «اشدد ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
32- (الواو) a conjunction; (أشركه) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is أنت «[Note: it may be an imperfect verb, jussive as the answer to a request, conjoined to the jussive imperfect أشدد in a reading of the Seven.]»; (في أمري) attached to (أشركه).
The clause «أشركه ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause اشدد..
33- (كي) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative; (كثيرا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, so it is an naʿt of it, i.e. "much glorification". The interpreted maṣdar (كي نسبّحك) is in the position of the genitive by an implied lām, attached to (اجعل) «[Note: it may be attached to the two verbs اشدد and أشرك.]».
The clause «نسبّحك ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (كي).
34- (الواو) a conjunction; (نذكرك) an imperfect verb conjoined to نسبّحك, accusative..
(كثيرا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar..
The clause «نذكرك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause نسبّحك.
35- (بنا) attached to (بصيرا), the khabar (predicate) of كنت, accusative.
The clause «إنّك كنت ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «كنت بنا بصيرا ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(وزيرا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral وزر (the pattern of ضرب), on the pattern فعيل, and it is either from الوز, which is "weight", because the wazīr bears the burdens of kingship, or from الوزر, which is "refuge"; and it is said that it is from المؤازرة, which is "assistance".
(أزر): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb أزر فلانا يأزره (the pattern of ضرب), i.e. "he strengthened him", on the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- Indefiniteness (tankīr):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسانِي».
Where he made العقدة indefinite, to show that he is not asking for the untying of the knot of his tongue entirely, but the untying of a knot that prevents making oneself understood; therefore he made it indefinite and described it by his saying: «مِنْ لِسانِي», i.e. a knot belonging to the knots of my tongue; and he made his saying: «يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي» the answer to the command and the aim of the supplication, for by its untying the granting of his request, upon him be peace, is realized.

* Benefits:
- The kinds of كي: the accusative-governing كي is of two kinds:
a- The maṣdar كي: that upon which the lām enters in wording, like «لِكَيْلا تَأْسَوْا عَلى ما فاتَكُمْ» and كي تكرمني.
b- The causal: it does not govern the accusative by itself, because it is a preposition; rather it puts the verb in the accusative by an implied "أن", necessarily in prose, and it may appear in poetry, like:
فقالت أكل الناس أصبحت مانحا ... لسانك كيما أن تغرّ وتخدعا
(She said: "Have you become, for all the people, one who grants his tongue — so that you may deceive and beguile?")
To that all the Basrans went; as for the Kufans, they see that كي puts the verb in the accusative, whether the lām precedes it or does not precede it.
And it is said that they agreed on the permissibility of separating between it and what it governs by «the negative لا and the redundant ما» and nothing else.

safi-cedvel:36-41.t:
* I'rab:
(أوتيت) a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the (تاء); (سؤلك) a direct object, accusative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قد أوتيت ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause of the vocative: «يا موسى» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
37- (الواو) a conjunction; (اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath; (عليك) attached to (مننّا); (مرّة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its number, i.e. "a second favour"; (أخرى) an naʿt (adjective) of مرّة, accusative, its sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif.
The clause «مننّا ...» has no grammatical position; the answer of the implied oath.. and the clause of the implied oath is conjoined to the clause أوتيت.
38- (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (مننّا); (إلى أمّك) attached to (أوحينا); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, a direct object, its governor being أوحينا; (يوحى) an imperfect passive verb, nominative, its sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and the nāʾib fāʿil is "هو", the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid).
The clause «أوحينا ...» is in the position of the genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «يوحى ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
39- (أن) explicative (tafsīriyya) «[Note: or a maṣdar particle.. and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative, a badal (substitute) for the relative noun ما يوحى.]»; (اقذفيه) an imperative, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the nominative, a fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, direct object; (في التابوت) attached to (اقذفيه); (الفاء) a conjunction; (في اليمّ) attached to the second (اقذفيه); (الفاء) a conjunction; (اللام) the lām of command, and the sign of the jussive in (يلقه) is the dropping of the weak letter; (بالساحل) attached to (يلقه), i.e. في الساحل «[Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the object, i.e. "in contact with the shore".]»; (يأخذه) an imperfect verb, jussive, the answer to a request; (لي) attached to an naʿt of the first (عدوّ); (له) attached to an naʿt of the second (عدوّ); (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl — or resumptive; (عليك) attached to (ألقيت); (منّي) attached to an naʿt of (محبّة) «[Note: or attached to (ألقيت).]»; (الواو) a conjunction; (اللام) for causation; (تصنع) a passive imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the nāʾib fāʿil is أنت; (على عيني) attached to (تصنع).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تصنع ...) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (ألقيت), and it is conjoined to an implied interpreted maṣdar, i.e. "I cast love upon you so that he would be kind to you and so that you would be formed under My eye".
The clause «اقذفيه ...» has no grammatical position; explicative.
The clause «اقذفيه (the second) ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the explicative.
The clause «يلقه اليمّ ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the explicative «[Note: it is a clause of request, but its meaning is a report.]».
The clause «يأخذه عدوّ ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of an implied condition, not accompanied by the fāʾ.
The clause «ألقيت ...» is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl, with an implied قد — or resumptive.
The clause «تصنع ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
40- (إذ) there are several aspects in its attachment: the first, attached to (ألقيت); the second, attached to (تصنع) على عيني; the third, a badal from إذ أوحينا; the fourth, it is an adverbial noun, a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); (هل) a particle of interrogation; (على من) attached to (أدلّكم); (الفاء) a conjunction; (إلى أمّك) attached to (رجعناك); (لا) negative; (تحزن) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to تقرّ, and the interpreted maṣdar (كي تقرّ..) is in the position of the genitive by an implied lām, attached to (رجعناك).
(الواو) resumptive; (الفاء) a conjunction; (من الغمّ) attached to (نجّيناك); (فتونا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative «[Note: or it is accusative by removal of the preposition if (فتونا) is the plural of فتنة, i.e. "We tried you with many trials".]»; (الفاء) resumptive; (سنين) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (لبثت), and its sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural; (في أهل) attached to (لبثت), and (مدين) is withheld from full declension for being a proper name and feminine; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (على قدر) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of جئت, i.e. "in agreement with what was decreed for you" or "being according to a fixed measure".
The clause «تمشي أختك ...» is in the position of the genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تقول ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause تمشي.
The clause «أدلّكم ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «يكفله ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «رجعناك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "so she was answered, so your mother came, so We returned you to her".
The clause «تقرّ عينها ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-relative (كي).
The clause «لا تحزن ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause تقرّ عينها.
The clause «قتلت ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive within the scope of the saying.
The clause «نجّيناك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause قتلت.
The clause «فتنّاك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause نجّيناك.
The clause «لبثت ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive within the scope of the saying.
The clause «جئت ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لبثت.
The clause of the vocative: «يا موسى» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
41- (الواو) a conjunction; (لنفسي) attached to (اصطنعتك).
The clause «اصطنعتك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جئت.

* Morphology:
(سؤلك): a noun for what is asked, i.e. with the meaning of "the thing asked for" (al-masʾūl), on the pattern فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(الساحل): a rigid noun with the meaning of "shore", and it is in the wording of the active participle of the triliteral سحل (the pattern of فتح).
(محبّة): a mīmī maṣdar of the triliteral حبّ, on the pattern مفعلة, and the (تاء) is for intensification.
(فتونا): a samāʿī maṣdar of the triliteral verb فتن (the pattern of ضرب), on the pattern فعول with two ḍammas, and there is another maṣdar of the verb, فتن with fatḥa then sukūn. And it is possible that (فتونا) is a plural of فتنة, in which case it is a noun.
(اصطنع): it has an ibdāl (substitution): the tāʾ of the form افتعال was changed to ṭāʾ because it comes after the ṣād, and its origin is اصتنعتك.

* Rhetoric:
1- Vagueness (ibhām):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «ما يُوحى» there is pure vagueness, and it is frequent in the Noble Qur'an.
2- Indefiniteness (tankīr): in His saying, Exalted is He, «محبة».
He made المحبة indefinite, because in making it indefinite there is an essential grandeur combined with an additive grandeur, i.e. a great love coming from Me which I have planted in hearts, so that everyone who saw you loved you, such that he could not be patient away from you.
3- Representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلى عَيْنِي».
A representation of the intensity of care and excess of preservation and guarding, by one who is made in sight of the observer, for the one who guards a thing — for the most part — keeps looking at it continually, so He represented that by one who is made under the eye of another.
4- Derivative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tabaʿiyya):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي».
He likened the nearness and selection with which He has endowed him to the state of one whom the king sees as worthy of honour and closeness of station, because of the praiseworthy qualities in him, so he fashions him, chooses him for his friendship and selects him for his weighty affairs, and He borrowed the word اصطنع for that.

* Benefits:
1- ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى.
What are the favours with which Allah favoured Mūsā?
The answer is that they may reach eight or more: a- His saying: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنا etc.
b- وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِنِّي.
c- His saying: وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلى عَيْنِي.
d- His saying: فَرَجَعْناكَ إِلى أُمِّكَ.
هـ- His saying: وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْساً فَنَجَّيْناكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ.
و وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُوناً.
ز- His saying: فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِي أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ, up to His saying, يا مُوسى.
ح- His saying: وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلى عَيْنِي.
«[Translator's note: the source lists the clause وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلى عَيْنِي twice (c and ح) and uses the lettering د, هـ, و, ز, ح; it is reproduced as written.]»
2- The explicative أن: it is that which occurs after what has the meaning of saying without its wording. Like His saying, Exalted is He: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنا إِلى أُمِّكَ ما يُوحى أَنِ اقْذِفِيهِ. up to His saying: «عَلى عَيْنِي».

safi-cedvel:121-124.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction, and (الألف) is the agent of (أكلا), (منها) attached to (أكلا), (الفاء) a conjunction, (بدت) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, implied on the alif that was omitted because of the meeting of two silent letters, and (التاء) is the feminine marker, (لهما) attached to (بدت), (الواو) a conjunction, (طفقا) an incomplete past verb of the verbs of commencement (afʿāl al-shurūʿ).. and (الألف) is the ism of ṭafiqa, (عليهما) attached to (يخصفان), (من ورق) attached to (يخصفان), (الواو) resumptive and (الفاء) a conjunction.
Clause: «أكلا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumptive.
And the clause: «بدت لهما سوءاتهما ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «أكلا».
And the clause: «طفقا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «بدت».
And the clause: «يخصفان ... » is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of ṭafiqa.
And the clause: «عصى آدم ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «غوى ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «عصى».
122- (عليه) attached to (تاب).
And the clause: «اجتباه ربّه ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «عصى»; and the clause: «تاب ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «اجتباه»; and the clause: «هدى ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «اجتباه».
(منها) attached to (اهبطا), (جميعا) an accusative ḥāl from the agent, (بعضكم) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, (لبعض) attached to a ḥāl from (عدو) [Note: or attached to (عدوّ).], which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, (الفاء) a conjunction, (إن) a conditional particle that jusses, (ما) redundant, (يأتينّكم) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of a jussive, the protasis.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and (كم) is a pronoun, a direct object, (منّي) attached to (يأتينّكم) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from (هدى).], (هدى) the agent, nominative, its sign of nominative being the implied ḍamma on the alif, (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis, (من) a conditional noun that jusses, indeclinable in the position of a nominative mubtadaʾ, (اتّبع) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a jussive, the protasis, and the agent is "huwa", (هداي) a direct object, accusative, its sign of accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi, (فلا يضلّ ولا يشقى) like (فلا يخاف).. [Note: in verse (112) of this sūra.].
And the clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.
And the clause: «اهبطا ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «بعضكم.. عدوّ ... » is in the position of an accusative, a second ḥāl from the agent of (اهبطا).
And the clause: «يأتينّكم.. هدى» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the content of what was said.
And the clause: «من اتّبع هداي ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the first condition, joined with the fāʾ.
And the clause: «اتّبع ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
And the clause: «لا يضلّ ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو"..
And the nominal clause «هو لا يضلّ» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the second condition, joined with the fāʾ.
And the clause: «لا يشقى ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause «لا يضلّ».
124- (الواو) a conjunction, (من أعرض) like (من اتّبع), (عن ذكري) attached to (أعرض), (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis, (له) attached to the khabar of inna, (معيشة) the ism of inna, placed later, accusative, (الواو) a conjunction, (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (نحشره), (أعمى) an accusative ḥāl from the third-person pronoun, and its sign of accusative is the implied fatḥa on the alif.
And the clause: «من أعرض ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause «من اتّبع» ...
And the clause: «إنّ له معيشة ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
And the clause: «أعرض ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
And the clause: «نحشره ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "نحن", and the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause of the apodosis of the condition..

* Morphology:
(عصى): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is عصي, the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif; its imperfect is يعصي, of the pattern of ضرب.
(غوى): it has an ʿilāl by substitution; its origin is غوي, the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif; its imperfect is يغوي - with a yāʾ - of the pattern of ضرب, and the past may come as غوي with a kasra on the wāw and the imperfect يغوى with a fatḥa on the wāw, of the pattern of فرح.. and the alif was written as an undotted yāʾ because its middle radical is a wāw.
(اجتباه): it has an ʿilāl by substitution; its origin is اجتبي, the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif, and it was written long because it came in the middle through the attachment of the third-person pronoun.
(معيشة): a samāʿī maṣdar of the triliteral verb عاش, on the pattern مفعلة with a fatḥa on the mīm and a kasra on the ʿayn, and the yāʾ was silenced and its vowel transferred to the ʿayn before it, as an ʿilāl by silencing.. and there are other maṣdars for the verb: عيش with a fatḥa and a sukūn, عيشة with a kasra on the ʿayn and a sukūn on the yāʾ, معاش with a fatḥa on the mīm, معيش without a tāʾ, and عيشوشة.
(ضنكا): a maṣdar of ضنك, of the pattern of كرم, on the pattern فعل with a fatḥa and a sukūn, i.e. "it was narrow"..
And there are other maṣdars: ضناكة with a fatḥa on the ḍād, and ضنوكة with a ḍamma on the ḍād.. (ضنكا) came masculine despite being a description of (معيشة) because it is a maṣdar.

* Benefits:
1- Between nouns of verbs (asmāʾ al-afʿāl) and nouns of sounds (asmāʾ al-aṣwāt), the differences between these two groups are almost confused for some people.
For nouns of verbs, the addressee is noticed, as is the time to which they are specific, in addition to the meaning they carry and indicate.
As for nouns of sounds, they are free of that, and are specific to animals to which the sounds are directed, or to things and living beings from which some sounds issue. They are of several kinds:
First: sounds with which one addresses what has no reason, such as:
جيء جيء: a call to camels to drink, and like their saying in calling sheep «حاحا», which in our days is used to urge donkeys to walk. And in calling goats «عاعا» is used, which is close to what the shepherd uses now, and like «عدس» for scolding the mule. As one of them said, when he had escaped arrest:
عدس ما لعباد عليك أمارة ... أمنت وهذا تحملين طليق
("ʿAdas! 'Ibād has no authority over you; you are safe, and this one you carry is free.")
Second: audible sounds, which are of two kinds:
a- Animal: such as «غاق», for the sound of the crow.
b- And «طق»: for the sound of striking or the fall of a stone.
Were it not for departing from the plan of the book, we would present to you many of the sounds of living and inanimate things that you will find in the longer works.

safi-cedvel:125-125.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّ) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (114) of this sūra.], (لم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حشرتني), and (ما) is an interrogative noun whose alif was dropped, (أعمى) an accusative ḥāl from the yāʾ, (الواو) circumstantial, (بصيرا) the khabar of kuntu, accusative.
Clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the vocative clause: «ربّ ... » has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
And the clause: «حشرتني ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «كنت بصيرا» is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the object of (حشرتني).

safi-cedvel:126-127.t:
* I'rab:
(كذلك) attached to an omitted absolute object whose governor is implied [Note: i.e. "thus - or like that - We gathered you" or "We did".. and it is possible that the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the matter is thus"..], (الواو) a conjunction, (كذلك) the second, attached to an omitted absolute object whose governor is (تنسى) [Note: i.e. "you are forgotten today with a forgetting like that forgetting of Our signs".], (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تنسى), which is a passive imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of nominative being the implied ḍamma on the alif, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you).
Clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: « (حشرناك حشرا) كذلك» is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «أتتك آياتنا ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «نسيتها ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «أتتك».
And the clause: «تنسى ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «نسيتها» [Note: it is possible that it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
127- (الواو) a conjunction, (كذلك) the third, an absolute object whose governor is (نجزي), and the agent of (نجزي) is "we", for magnification, (من) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative direct object, (بآيات) attached to (يؤمن), (الواو) resumptive, (اللام) the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis..
And the clause: «نجزي ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the content of what was said.
And the clause: «أسرف ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative (من).
And the clause: «لم يؤمن ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «عذاب الآخرة أشدّ ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.

safi-cedvel:128-128.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative, (الفاء) resumptive, and the sign of the jussive in (يهد) is the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent of (يهد) is omitted, indicated by the context of the speech, its implied form being (الإهلاك) ("the destruction") [Note: and it is possible that the agent is a latent pronoun referring to Allah the Exalted, i.e. "Allah makes clear to them" ...], (لهم) attached to (يهد), by giving it the sense of "makes clear", (كم) a declarative or interrogative, indeclinable in the position of an accusative direct object whose governor is (أهلكنا), (قبلهم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أهلكنا), (من القرون) attached to an omitted adjective of (كم) [Note: it is not permissible for (من القرون) to be the tamyīz of (كم) because it is definite; so the tamyīz is implied, i.e. "how many a generation" or "how many generations"], (في مساكنهم) attached to (يمشون), (في ذلك) attached to the khabar of inna, and (اللام) is the lām of emphasis, (آيات) the ism of inna, placed later, accusative, and its sign of accusative is the kasra, (لأولي) attached to an adjective of (لآيات), and its sign of genitive is the yāʾ, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural, (النهى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its sign of genitive being the implied kasra on the alif.
Clause: «يهد ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: according to the grammarians it is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "were they heedless, so that it did not guide them?"].
And the clause: «أهلكنا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the direct object of (يهد), which is suspended (muʿallaq) by (كم), meaning "makes clear", which contains the sense of knowing.
And the clause: «يمشون ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl.
And the clause: «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.

safi-cedvel:42-44.t:
* I'rab:
(أنت) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, emphasis (tawkīd) of the latent pronoun fāʿil (agent); (أخوك) conjoined to the latent fāʿil pronoun by the wāw, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw; (بآياتي) attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the conjoined and the one conjoined to, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on what precedes the yāʾ; (لا) prohibitive, jussive; (تنيا) an imperfect verb, jussive, its sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الألف) is the fāʿil; (في ذكري) attached to (تنيا), and (في) has the meaning of (عن); (إلى فرعون) attached to (اذهبا); (له) attached to (قولا); (قولا) a direct object, accusative «[Note: or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the direct object is implied, i.e. "say to him what will guide him, gentle speech".]», i.e. gentle speech.
The clause «اذهب ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا تنيا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «اذهبا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive, confirming the first.
The clause «إنّه طغى ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «طغى ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «قولا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause اذهبا.
The clause «لعلّه يتذكّر ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption — or causal.
The clause «يتذكّر ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of لعلّ.
The clause «يخشى ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يتذكّر.

* Morphology:
(تنيا): it has a weak-letter change by omission; its past is ونى, of the pattern of وعد; its fāʾ was dropped in the imperfect, so it is a weak verb of the "mithāl" type with kasra on the ʿayn in the imperfect; its pattern is تعلا.
(ليّنا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral لان يلين (the pattern of ضرب), on the pattern فيعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and kasra on the ʿayn; the yāʾ was merged with the ʿayn of the word, which is a yāʾ.

* Benefits:
- The aspects of hope in His saying, Exalted is He:
«لَعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشى»:
a- That the hope is on its original meaning, for the two of them hope for his faith and desire his guidance; and if hope is valid in the servant, it is impossible in respect of Allah the Exalted:
b- That لعل gives the sense of causation, in the position of «كي».
c- Some of them considered it interrogative, and interrogation is impossible in respect of Allah.
ء- The grammarians say that لعل is for expectation (tawaqquʿ), and it gives hope (tarajjī), like His saying, Exalted is He: لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ أَمْراً. And likewise apprehension (ishfāq), like «فَلَعَلَّكَ باخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ», i.e. "have mercy on yourself".
هـ- al-Akhfash and al-Kisāʾī stated that it may give causation, like your saying to your companion «Finish your work, لعلنا we may have lunch». And among it is «لعله يتزكى», i.e. يتذكر.

safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(علينا) attached to (يفرط).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفرط..) is in the position of the accusative, a direct object, its governor being نخاف.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يطغى) is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar (أن يفرط..).
The clause «قالا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ربّنا (the vocative) ...» has no grammatical position; parenthetical, for seeking mercy.
The clause «إنّنا نخاف ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نخاف ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «يفرط ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يطغى ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second (أن).

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) prohibitive, jussive; (معكما) an accusative adverb attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ.. and (كما) is a pronoun, a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the object of each of (أسمع، أرى) is implied, i.e.: "I hear what he says and I see what he does".
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «لا تخافا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّني معكما ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «أسمع ...» is in the position of the nominative, a second khabar of (إنّ) «[Note: or it has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.. or it is in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the ism (noun) of إنّ, and the governor in it is the sense of emphasis (إنّ).]».

safi-cedvel:47-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction; (ائتياه) a verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn..
and (الألف) is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) is a direct object; (الفاء) in (فأرسل) connects the effect with the cause; (معنا) an accusative adverb attached to (أرسل); (بني) a direct object, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural, and (إسرائيل) is withheld from full declension for being a proper name and foreign; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive; (قد) a particle of confirmation; (بآية) attached to (جئناك); (من ربك) attached to an naʿt (adjective) of آية; (الواو) resumptive; (على من) attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (السلام).
The clause «ائتياه ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لا تخافا «[Note: in the preceding verse (46).]».
The clause «قولا ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ائتياه.
The clause «إنّا رسولا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أرسل ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "be alert, and send".
The clause «لا تعذّبهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أرسل.
The clause «قد جئناك ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption — or causal.
The clause «السلام على من ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
48- (أوحي) a passive past verb; (إلينا) attached to (أوحي); (على من) attached to an omitted khabar of أنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ العذاب..) is in the position of the nominative, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb أوحي.
The clause «إنّا قد أوحي ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the saying «[Note: it is the clause السلام على من اتبع ... so it is from the saying of Mūsā and Hārūn to Pharaoh.. or the saying of Allah to them, that they say that to Pharaoh.]»; and the clause «أوحي إلينا ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «كذّب ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من); and the clause «تولّى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كذّب.

* Morphology:
(ائتيا): the hamzat al-waṣl has been dropped from it because of the presence of a hamza after it and the entry of the fāʾ on the verb, so it became (فأتياه), where the hamza was written on an alif after having been written on a nabra (yāʾ-seat).

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is (ربّكما).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «من ربّكما ...» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if it has been revealed to you, then who is your Lord?" And the implied conditional clause is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) «[Note: it is possible that the interrogative clause is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: "we have heard this, so who is your Lord?" And the implied is the content of the saying.]».
The clause «يا موسى ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive — or parenthetical.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, a khabar (predicate); (خلقه) a second direct object, accusative «[Note: this is on the view that الخلق has the meaning of form or shape; but if the meaning is creatures and people, it is the first object and (كلّ) is the second object.]».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «ربّنا الذي ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أعطى كلّ ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «هدى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أعطى..

* Morphology:
(خلقه): a noun with the meaning of form and natural disposition, i.e. الخلقة with kasra; and if it has the meaning of "people", then it is a collective noun, on the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (بال) the khabar (predicate), nominative..
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما بال ...» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if your Lord has given and guided, then what of the state of ..." «[Note: it is possible that the clause is conjoined to an implied clause which is the content of the saying, like verse (49) of this sūra.]», and the implied conditional clause is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.

* Morphology:
(الأولى): the feminine of الأول, a noun of number which indicates order and agrees with the counted in masculine and feminine; it has come feminine because it is a description of القرون, which is a plural, and the plural is feminine. Its pattern is فعلى with ḍamma then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:129-132.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (لولا) a particle of prevention due to existence, containing the sense of a condition, (كلمة) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "existing", (من ربّك) attached to (سبقت), (اللام) the connective of the apodosis of (لولا), and the ism of (كان) is a pronoun referring back to the hasty destruction, (الواو) a conjunction, (أجل) conjoined to (كلمة), nominative [Note: or conjoined to the pronoun, the ism of kāna, and the separation by the khabar made emphasis unnecessary.], (مسمّى) an adjective (naʿt) of (أجل), nominative, its sign of nominative being the implied ḍamma on the alif.
Clause: «كلمة سبقت ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «سبقت من ربّك ... » is in the position of a nominative, an adjective of (كلمة).
And the clause: «كان (الإهلاك) لزاما ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
130- (الفاء) the connective of an implied conditional apodosis, (على ما) attached to (اصبر), and (ما) is a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun with the returning pronoun omitted.], (بحمد) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of (سبّح), i.e. "joined with the praise of your Lord", (قبل) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (سبّح), (الواو) a conjunction, (قبل) the second, conjoined to the first, (الواو) a conjunction, (من آناء) attached to the second (سبّح), and (الفاء) is redundant, for embellishment [Note: or a conjunction to an implied clause, or the connective of an implied conditional apodosis.], (الواو) a conjunction, (أطراف) conjoined to (قبل) [Note: or conjoined to the position of (من آناء), because its position is accusative, being an adverbial of (سبّح).], and attached to what it is attached to, accusative, (ترضى) an imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of nominative being the implied ḍamma, and the agent is "you".
And the clause: «اصبر ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you hear what hurts you, then be patient".
And the clause: «يقولون ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما يقولون..) is in the position of a genitive by the preposition, attached to (اصبر).
And the clause: «سبّح ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause «اصبر».
And the clause: «سبّح (the second)» is conjoined to the clause «سبّح» (the first).
And the clause: «لعلّك ترضى ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.
And the clause: «ترضى ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of laʿalla.
131- (الواو) a conjunction, (لا) a prohibitive that jusses, (تمدّنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of a jussive.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is "you", and the sign of accusative in (عينيك) is the yāʾ, for it is a dual, (إلى ما) attached to (تمدّنّ).. and (ما) is a relative noun or an indefinite described noun, (به) attached to (متّعنا) and (الباء) is causal, (أزواجا) a direct object, accusative [Note: and the governor is (متّعنا); it is possible that it is a ḥāl from the pronoun in (به), regarding in it the sense of (ما), which is plural.], (منهم) attached to an adjective of (أزواجا), (زهرة) a ḥāl from the pronoun in (به), which is the returning pronoun to (ما) [Note: it came as a rigid noun because it indicates a likening.. and it is possible that it is 1- a second direct object by giving (متّعنا) the sense of "We gave", the first object being (أزواجا), 2- a badal from (أزواجا) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "possessors of splendour", 3- a direct object of an implied verb, i.e. "We made for them splendour" ...], (اللام) for cause, (نفتنهم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the lām, and (هم) is a direct object, and the agent is "we", for magnification, (فيه) attached to (نفتنهم).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن نفتنهم..) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (متّعنا).
(الواو) resumptive, (أبقى) conjoined to (خير), nominative, its sign of nominative being the implied ḍamma on the alif.
And the clause: «لا تمدّنّ ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause «اصبر».
And the clause: «متّعنا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative (ما) [Note: or in the position of a genitive, an adjective of the indefinite described (ما).].
And the clause: «نفتنهم ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «رزق ربّك خير ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
132- (الواو) a conjunction, (بالصلاة) attached to (اومر), (عليها) attached to (اصطبر), (لا) negative, (رزقا) a second direct object, accusative, (للتقوى) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and in it there is an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "for the people of piety"..
And the clause: «اومر ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause «لا تمدّنّ».
And the clause: «اصطبر ... » is conjoined to the clause «اومر».
And the clause: «نسألك ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «نحن نرزقك ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «نرزقك ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (نحن).
And the clause: «العاقبة للتقوى ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: or conjoined to a resumptive.].

* Morphology:
(لزاما): the maṣdar of the quadriliteral لازم, a samāʿī maṣdar, on the pattern فعال with a kasra on the first letter, and the maṣdar has the sense of an active participle.
(طلوع): a maṣdar of the triliteral طلع, of the pattern of نصر, on the pattern فعول with a ḍamma on the first letter.
(غروب): a maṣdar of the triliteral غرب, of the pattern of نصر, on the pattern فعول with a ḍamma on the first letter.
(زهرة): a rigid noun for a known kind of plant, on the pattern فعلة with a fatḥa and a sukūn.
(وأمر): the hamzat al-waṣl is omitted in it; its origin is اومر; the hamza was written on a wāw because the vowel of the hamzat al-waṣl, if it is vowelled, is ḍamma, and the middle radical of the verb in the imperfect has a ḍamma; when the wāw came before the verb, the hamzat al-waṣl was omitted, and the second hamza was converted to an alif as is the rule.

* Rhetoric:
- Comparative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī):
In His words, the Exalted, «زَهْرَةَ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا».
He gave the favours of this world the likeness of flowers, which are blossoms, because flowers have a beautiful look, then wither and vanish, and so is the pleasure of this world.

* Benefits:
1- Abrogation (naskh) in the Qur'an:
His words: فَاصْبِرْ عَلى ما يَقُولُونَ: many exegetes claimed that this verse is abrogated by the verse of fighting. In our view, it commands patience and not rising in anger and committing folly in every situation that requires forbearance and patience with what is disliked. It appears that the Companions used abrogation in a sense different from the sense of the jurists and the scholars of legal theory. The later scholars went toward reducing abrogation in the Qur'an, until they did not exceed twenty verses, and even inclined to interpret what the early ones claimed to be abrogated. Imam Muḥammad ʿAbduh denied abrogation in the Qur'an and said: everything they claimed to be abrogated can be interpreted, as we saw in this verse «فَاصْبِرْ عَلى ما يَقُولُونَ». There is no doubt that the old claim that the abrogated verses reach about five hundred is self-evidently false, and contains much exaggeration and excess.
2- زَهْرَةَ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا:
The grammarians went various ways in parsing it, all of them pouring into the case of the accusative; and here are the most important, nine in number:
a- That it is a second direct object, as we noticed that (أزواجا) is the first object, because the meaning of (متّعنا) is "We gave".
b- That it is accusative as a ḥāl from the relative (ما).
c- That it is accusative as a badal from (أزواجا), by way of exaggeration, as if they were the very flower.
d- That it is accusative by an implied verb, indicated by the verb (متّعنا), its implied form being "We made for them".
e- That it is accusative as "blame" (al-dhamm), i.e. blaming the life of this world.
And that it is accusative as "specification" (al-ikhtiṣāṣ). [Translator's note: the source gives no letter for this item; the lettering continues أ ب ج ء هـ, then a letter-less item, then ز ج ط, as printed.]
g- That it is accusative as a "badal" from the position of «به».
h- That it is accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun present in «به».
i- That it is accusative as a tamyīz of «ما» or of the hāʾ in «به».
Al-Zamakhsharī preferred, among these aspects, the accusative of blame, or the object reading with (متّعنا) given the sense of "We gave"..!

safi-cedvel:133-133.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (لولا) a particle of urging, (بآية) attached to (يأتينا), (من ربّه) attached to an adjective of (لآية), (الهمزة) for the interrogative, (الواو) a conjunction, (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi, (في الصحف) attached to an omitted ṣila of (ما), (الأولى) an adjective (naʿt) of (الصحف), genitive, its sign of genitive being the implied kasra on the alif.
Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يأتينا بآية ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «لم تأتهم بيّنة ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: "Have the other signs not come to them, and has the clear proof not come to them?"

* Morphology:
(الصحف): the plural of الصحيفة, a name for the sheet on which one writes, on the pattern فعيلة, and the pattern of الصحف is فعل with two ḍammas.. and الصحيفة is also pluralised as صحائف, on the pattern فعائل.

safi-cedvel:134-135.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle, (بعذاب) attached to (أهلكناهم), (من قبله) attached to (أهلكناهم).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّا أهلكناهم..) is in the position of a nominative, the agent of an omitted verb, its implied form being "it was established", i.e. "Our destroying them was established".
(اللام) the connective of the apodosis of (لو), (لولا) for urging, (إلينا) attached to (أرسلت), (الفاء) the fāʾ of causality, (نتّبع) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the fāʾ, and the agent is "we", and the sign of accusative in (آياتك) is the kasra, (من قبل) attached to (نتّبع).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن نتّبع) is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding urging, i.e.: "let there be a sending from You, then a following of Your signs by us".
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن نذلّ..) is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
Clause: « (ثبت) إهلاكنا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «أهلكناهم ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of anna.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «النداء وجوابه ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «لولا أرسلت ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
And the clause: «نتّبع ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «نذلّ ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the overt particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «نخزى ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause «نذلّ».
135- (كلّ) a mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: what made it permissible to begin with an indefinite is that it indicates generality, and it is in the sense of annexation, i.e. "each one".], (الفاء) a conjunction linking the effect to the cause, (الفاء) the second is causal, and (السين) is a particle of the future, (من) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative direct object [Note: or it is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (أصحاب).. and the clause is in the position of an accusative direct object of the verb of knowing, suspended by the interrogative.], (أصحاب) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم", (من) the second is like the first and conjoined to it [Note: or it is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause (اهتدى), the clause being in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the first nominal clause.].
And the clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory resumptive.
And the clause: «كلّ متربّص ... » is in the position of an accusative, being the content of what was said.
And the clause: «تربّصوا ... » is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause caused by what precedes it, i.e.: "be alert, and so wait"..
And the clause: «ستعلمون ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: « (هم) أصحاب ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative (من).
And the clause: «اهتدى ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative.

* Morphology:
(نخزى): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is نخزي - with a yāʾ at the end - the yāʾ having a vowel after a fatḥa was changed to an alif.

safi-cedvel:52-53.t:
* I'rab:
(علمها) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, with a muḍāf ilayhi; (عند) an accusative adverb attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) «[Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in علمها, and the khabar is the preposition and its noun (في كتاب) ..
There are other artificial attachments reported by al-ʿUkbarī, citing al-Akhfash and others.]»; (في كتاب) attached to the omitted khabar; (لا) negative in both places.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «علمها عند ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا يضلّ ربّي ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the saying «[Note: the clause may be an naʿt of كتاب, in the position of the genitive, with the connector omitted, i.e. "my Lord does not lose its preservation".. and the conjoined clause لا ينسى takes its parsing.]».
The clause «لا ينسى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا يضلّ ربّي.
53- (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو" «[Note: or in the position of the genitive, an naʿt of ربّي.]»; the first (لكم) attached to (جعل) «[Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from (مهدا).]»; (مهدا) a second direct object, accusative; the second (لكم) attached to (سلك) «[Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from (سبلا).]»; (فيها) attached to (سلك); (من السماء) attached to (أنزل) «[Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from (ماء).]»; (الفاء) a conjunction; (به) attached to (أخرجنا), and (الباء) is for causality; (من نبات) attached to an naʿt of (أزواجا); (شتّى) a second naʿt of (أزواجا), accusative, its sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif.
The clause «(هو) الذي ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the preceding saying; and the clause «جعل ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «سلك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause of the ṣila.
The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause of the ṣila.
The clause «أخرجنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أنزل «[Note: and in the speech there is an iltifāt (shift of address); the meaning is "and He brought forth with it pairs ...".]».

* Morphology:
(شتّى): the plural of شتيت, an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from شتّ الأمر يشتّ (the pattern of ضرب), on the pattern فعيل; and the pattern of شتّى is فعلى, like مريض and مرضى, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(في ذلك) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ; (اللام) the lām of ibtidāʾ (commencement), for emphasis; (آيات) the ism (noun) of أنّ, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra; (لأولي) attached to an naʿt (adjective) of (لآيات), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural..
The clause «كلوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: they permitted the clause to be a saying (maqūl) of an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "We brought forth with it pairs, saying: eat ...".]».
The clause «ارعوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كلوا.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ارعوا): it has a weak-letter change by omission; its origin is ارعاوا; two silent letters met, the alif and the wāw, so the alif, the lām of the word, was dropped, and the fatḥa remained on the ʿayn as an indication of the alif; its pattern is افعوا.
(النهى): it is said that it is a maṣdar like الهدى and السري, on the pattern فعل with ḍamma then fatḥa; and it is said that it is the plural of نهية, like غرفة with ḍamma then sukūn, and غرف; it was so named because it restrains its possessor from committing what is not fitting; and it has a weak-letter change by conversion; its origin is نهي; the yāʾ was vowelled and what precedes it had fatḥa, so it was converted to alif.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
The first (منها) attached to (خلقناكم); (فيها) attached to (نعيدكم); the second (منها) attached to (نخرجكم); (تارة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "another bringing forth" «[Note: it may be parsed as an adverb attached to (نخرجكم), i.e. "We shall bring you forth at a second time".]»; (أخرى) an naʿt (adjective) of تارة, accusative, its sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa.
The clause «خلقناكم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «نعيدكم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «نخرجكم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تارة): a noun with the meaning "time" and "occasion"; its verb is تأر, and the hamza was dropped because of frequent use; its plural is تارات and تير with kasra then fatḥa, and تئر with the hamza.

* Rhetoric:
- Antithesis (muqābala):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «مِنْها خَلَقْناكُمْ وَفِيها نُعِيدُكُمْ».
Antithesis has been achieved between «منها» and «فيها», and between «الخلق» and «الإعادة». And this is one of the badīʿ embellishments.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of confirmation; (آياتنا) a second direct object, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra.. and (نا) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كلّها) emphasis (tawkīd) of الآيات, accusative; (الفاء) a conjunction.
The clause «أريناه ...» has no grammatical position; the answer of the implied oath.
The clause «كذّب ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أريناه.
The clause «أبي ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أريناه.

safi-cedvel:57-58.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation, and (اللام) the lām of causation; (تخرجنا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; (من أرضنا) attached to (تخرجنا); (بسحرك) attached to (تخرجنا), and (الباء) is for causality..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تخرجنا..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (جئتنا).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «جئتنا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تخرجنا ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause of the vocative: «يا موسى ...» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
58- (الفاء) a conjunction; (اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath; (نأتينّك) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and (الكاف) is a direct object, and the fāʿil (agent) is نحن (we), for glorification; (بسحر) attached to (نأتينّك) «[Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of نأتينّك, i.e. "being equipped with magic".]»; (مثله) an naʿt of سحر, genitive; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (بيننا) an accusative adverb attached to an omitted second direct object; (بينك) conjoined to the first adverb; (موعدا) a first direct object, accusative; (لا) negative; (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, emphasis of the latent pronoun of the fāʿil; (لا) the second is redundant, to confirm the negation; (أنت) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the pronoun of the fāʿil — and according to Ibn Mālik, أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, a fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "تخلفه" — since when the verb is omitted the fāʿil becomes detached — so it is not an emphasis of the latent fāʿil in (نخلفه). In that case the clause تخلفه is conjoined to the clause نخلفه in the position of the accusative.. but the first parsing relies on the rule: "what is not tolerated at the beginnings is tolerated at the ends". (مكانا) a badal (substitute) from (موعدا), given that it is a noun of place, accusative «[Note: or it is a second direct object of (اجعل), on the basis that the adverb (بين) is attached to the verb اجعل and that الموعد is a noun of place.. or it is an adverb of place attached to (اجعل).. As for what Abū al-Baqāʾ decided and al-Suyūṭī followed him in, that it is accusative by removal of the preposition, it is rejected because the governor is transitive by itself, namely اجعل.]»; (سوى) an naʿt of (مكانا), accusative, its sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif.
