The clause «نأتينّك ...» has no grammatical position; the answer of the implied oath, and the implied clause of the oath is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the saying.
The clause «اجعل ...» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you accept the meeting, then appoint..".
The clause «لا نخلفه ...» is in the position of the accusative, an naʿt of (موعدا).

* Morphology:
(موعدا): it may be a mīmī maṣdar, or a noun of time, or a noun of place, from the verb وعد, on the pattern مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(سوى): a noun with the meaning "middle", on the pattern فعل with ḍamma then fatḥa, and it is read سوى with kasra on the sīn.

* Benefits:
- «مَكاناً سُوىً».
In the parsing of «مكانا» there are five aspects, namely:
a- Some made it a badal from an omitted «مكان».
b- Some considered it a second direct object of «جعل», among them Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī and Abū al-Baqāʾ.
c- That it is accusative by the maṣdar itself.
ء- That it is accusative as an adverb by the verb «اجعل».
هـ- That it is accusative by an implied verb. As for the word «موعد», it is said: a noun of time, and it is said: a noun of place.. and it is said: a mīmī maṣdar with the meaning of الموعد, and this is our view which we support and adopt, and this view requires the implication of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «مكان الموعد».

safi-cedvel:59-59.t:
* I'rab:
(موعدكم) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative.. and (كم) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يوم) the khabar (predicate), nominative; (يحشر) a passive imperfect verb, accusative by (أن); (الناس) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (ضحى) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يحشر), its sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحشر..) is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to يوم «[Note: or in the position of the genitive, conjoined to (الزينة), i.e. "and the day on which the people are gathered in the forenoon".]».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «موعدكم يوم ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يحشر الناس ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:60-60.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive, and the second (الفاء) a conjunction; (كيده) an omitted muḍāf is in it, i.e. "the people of his scheme" (dhawī kaydihi), a direct object, accusative.
The clause «تولّى فرعون ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «جمع ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «أتى ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جمع.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(لهم) attached to (قال); (ويلكم) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb that is not in use, accusative «[Note: it is not permissible to parse it as a direct object — as al-Jamal permitted — when (ويل) is annexed to the pronoun; that is permissible only when it comes unannexed (ويلا), for it is then a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ألزمك الله ويلا" (may Allah impose woe upon you).]»; (لا) prohibitive, jussive; (على الله) attached to (تفتروا); (كذبا) a direct object, accusative «[Note: or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar because it meets it in meaning, i.e. "do not fabricate a fabrication against Allah" or "do not lie a lie".]»; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causality (يسحتكم); (الواو) resumptive; (قد) a particle of confirmation..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يسحتكم..) is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, i.e.: "let there be no fabrication from you, lest there be a destruction from Allah by punishment..".
The clause «قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ويلكم ...» has no grammatical position; parenthetical, an imprecation.
The clause «لا تفتروا ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «يسحتكم ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «خاب من ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «افترى ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).

safi-cedvel:62-62.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (بينهم) an accusative adverb attached to (تنازعوا); (الواو) a conjunction.
The clause «تنازعوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أسرّوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause تنازعوا.

safi-cedvel:63-64.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) lightened from the heavy (inna), and its ism (noun) is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted «[Note: it may be neglected (muhmala), in which case (هذان) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (ساحران) a khabar (predicate), and (اللام) is the distinguishing lām which indicates that (إن) is the lightened one.. and they said: (إن) is negative and (اللام) has the meaning of إلّا, and there is remoteness in this.]»; (هذان) a mubtadaʾ in the position of the nominative, indeclinable on the alif; (اللام) the lām of ibtidāʾ (commencement); (ساحران) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هما"; (يريدان) an imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and (الألف) is the fāʿil (agent); (يخرجاكم) an imperfect verb, accusative, its sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and (الألف) is the fāʿil, and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object; (من أرضكم) attached to (يخرجاكم); (بسحرهما) attached to (يخرجاكم), and (الباء) is for causality.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرجاكم) is in the position of the accusative, a direct object, its governor being يريدان.
(الواو) a conjunction; (بطريقتكم) attached to (يذهبا); (المثلى) an naʿt (adjective) of طريقتكم, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إن (هـ) هذان لساحران» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هذان ل (هما) ساحران» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the lightened إن.
The clause «(هما) ساحران» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هذان).
The clause «يريدان ...» is in the position of the nominative, an naʿt of ساحران.
The clause «يخرجاكم ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يذهبا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يخرجاكم.
64- (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (صفّا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, i.e. "in ranks" (muṣtaffīn); (الواو) resumptive; (اليوم) an accusative adverb attached to (أفلح); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, a fāʿil.
The clause «أجمعوا ...» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you want victory, then gather".
The clause «ائتوا ...» is conjoined to the clause أجمعوا.
The clause «أفلح.. من استعلى» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «استعلى ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).

* Morphology:
(طريقة): a noun with the meaning of the notables of the people and their nobles; and in al-Qāmūs: الطريقة is the noble of the people and their best, for singular and plural, and it is pluralized as طرائق; its pattern is فعيلة.
(المثلى): a noun of preference (ism tafḍīl), on the pattern فعلى with ḍamma then sukūn, the feminine of الأمثل on the pattern أفعل.
It has come as a singular in the verse out of regard for the wording and not the meaning, because a noun of preference defined with (ال) must agree with the preceding noun «[Translator's note: the source states the agreement rule as written; the singular form is explained by the author as regard for the wording.]».
(استعلى): it has a weak-letter change by conversion; the alif is converted from a yāʾ, its triliteral base being علا يعلو.. and it is written as an undotted yāʾ because it is the sixth letter, and the yāʾ at its end was converted to alif because what precedes it has fatḥa; its imperfect is يستعلي.

safi-cedvel:65-65.t:
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تلقي..) is in the position of the nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted «[Note: i.e. "your casting is first".. and it is possible that the maṣdar is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "either the matter is your casting ..."]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نكون..) is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.
(أوّل) the khabar of نكون, accusative; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ألقى) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause of the vocative: «يا موسى ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) «[Note: it may be parenthetical, with no position, and the clause: أن تلقي (أوّل) in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.]».
The clause «(إلقاؤك) أوّل ...» has no grammatical position; the answer to the vocative.
The clause «تلقي ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «نكون ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second particle-relative.
The clause «ألقى ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
«[Translator's note: this entry has no "I'rab" heading in the source; it begins directly with the interpreted maṣdar.]»

safi-cedvel:66-67.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) for transitional rejection (iḍrāb intiqālī); (الفاء) a conjunction; (إذا) of suddenness; (حبالهم) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (يخيّل) a passive imperfect verb, nominative; (إليه) attached to (يخيّل); (من سحرهم) attached to (يخيّل), and (من) is causal «[Note: some make the preposition and its noun a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) in the manner of transgression (mujāwaza).]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّها تسعى..) is in the position of the nominative, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) «[Note: and whoever makes the nāʾib fāʿil a latent pronoun referring to the ropes and the staffs makes the interpreted maṣdar a badal ishtimāl (inclusive substitute) for the pronoun.]».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ألقوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive, and the content of the saying is implied, i.e.: "He said: I shall not cast first; rather, you cast".
The clause «حبالهم ... يخيّل» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "so they cast, and lo, their ropes ...".
The clause «يخيّل ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ حبالهم.
The clause «تسعى ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
67- (الفاء) a conjunction (في نفسه) (attached) to (أوجس); (خيفة) a direct object, accusative. «[Translator's note: the source text of this sentence is garbled; it is rendered as written.]»
The clause «أوجس ... موسى» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause حبالهم.. يخيّل.

* Morphology:
(عصيّهم): it has a weak-letter change by conversion; its origin is عصوو on the pattern فعول with two ḍammas.. then the second wāw was converted to yāʾ first to avoid heaviness, then the first wāw was converted to yāʾ because it came silent first, then the two yāʾs were merged together, so it became عصيّ with ḍamma on the ʿayn and the ṣād, then the ṣād was given kasra to suit the yāʾ, then the ʿayn was given kasra by adjacency, so it became عصيّ with kasra on the ʿayn and the ṣād and a doubled yāʾ.
(خيفة): a maṣdar of خاف, and it has a weak-letter change by conversion; its origin is خوفة with kasra on the khāʾ and fatḥa on the fāʾ, with a silent wāw between them; then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because of its being silent and the kasra before it, so it became خيفة; its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:68-69.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) prohibitive, jussive; (أنت) a detached pronoun borrowed for the position of the accusative, emphasis (tawkīd) of the attached pronoun, the ism (noun) of إنّ «[Note: the pronoun may be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الأعلى, and the nominal clause أنت الأعلى the khabar of إنّ.]»; (الأعلى) the khabar of إنّ, nominative, its sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif.
The clause «قلنا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا تخف ...» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّك.. الأعلى» has no grammatical position; causal.
69- (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, a direct object; (في يمينك) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (تلقف) an imperfect verb, jussive, the answer to a request, and the fāʿil (agent) is "هي"; (ما) like the first, its governor being تلقف, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "what they have made"; (ما) a relative noun, the ism of إنّ «[Note: (إنّما) is written in the muṣḥaf joined, though by right it should be separate.. and it is possible that (ما) is a maṣdar particle, and the parsing is the same for the maṣdar.]», in the position of the accusative; (كيد) the khabar of إنّ, nominative; (الواو) a conjunction — or resumptive; (حيث) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, attached to (يفلح).
The clause «ألق ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the saying.
The clause «تلقف ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of an implied condition, not accompanied by the fāʾ, i.e.: "if you cast what.. it will swallow".
The clause «صنعوا ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما).
The clause «إنّ ما صنعوا كيد ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «صنعوا (the second) ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «لا يفلح الساحر ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّ ما صنعوا..
The clause «أتى ...» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (حيث) to it.

* Rhetoric:
1- Emphatics (al-muʾakkidāt):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْأَعْلى».
He emphasized with several emphatics, namely «إنّ», which gives emphasis, the repetition of the pronoun «أنت», the definiteness of the khabar «الأعلى», the word "highness" (ʿuluw) which indicates dominance, and the form of preference «الأعلى».
2- Vagueness (ibhām):
In His saying, Exalted is He, «وَأَلْقِ ما فِي يَمِينِكَ» vagueness was preferred to magnify its matter and glorify its standing, and to announce that it is not of the genus of the familiar staffs that bring about customary effects, but goes beyond the bounds of the other members of the genus, vague, yet bringing about strange effects; and as if the staff, for the grandeur of its standing, is not encompassed by the sphere of knowledge, like «فَغَشِيَهُمْ مِنَ الْيَمِّ ما غَشِيَهُمْ».
It is also possible that the vagueness is for belittlement, in that it is meant: "Do not mind the multitude of their ropes and staffs, and cast the stick that is in your hand, for by the power of Allah the Exalted it will swallow them, despite its singleness and their multitude, and its smallness and their greatness."
